case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: Theoretical part of the training... divided into three 15-minute games, each one related to a specific objective. For objective 1, the process's 16 steps were printed on cards that had to be put back into the right order.
object_definition: The codified steps and procedures for preparing chemotherapy using the PharmaHelp robot.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: For objective 2, fake Pokémon like cards presenting a compound and its specificities... were used. One team picked a card and read out the information written on it; the other team had to guess whether the compound could be used with the robot and why.
object_definition: Rules and conditions determining which compounds and processes are suitable for robot automation.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: For objective 3, we created a game... incorporating six problematic, real-life situations. Each problem was presented with four potential answers, which teams had to discuss and select the correct one.
object_definition: Pre-defined protocols for responding to different types of production errors that occur during robot operation.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: Participants were asked to complete the survey at least one week before the training program. This survey of 10 questions scored from 0-24 examined operators' knowledge about the robot itself and our hospital's process for using it.
object_definition: A standardized set of questions used to assess operators' explicit knowledge about the robot and related procedures.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: For the preparatory work, participants read the institution's internal procedures about working with the robot and watched a video about the robot, at least 1 week before the training program.

case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot

node_name: Practical part using adapted Peyton approach
case_title: Game-based learning as training to use a chemotherapy preparation robot
evidence_statement: For the practical part, one team at a time (trainer/trainee) entered the cleanroom with the training pharmacist. Using an adapted version of the Peyton approach, the trainer became the trainee, and the trainee became the trainer.
object_definition: A hands-on, simulation-based training module where roles are reversed, allowing the trainee to demonstrate and explain the procedure while the trainer observes and corrects.
